verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows merchant-facing controls to rate-limit, allowlist, or block specific AI agents or agent platforms from the catalog or checkout. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: PayPal-issued JWT verification on the cart API, configurable amount and time limits on single-use payment tokens, Google-side UCP enablement, and a general promise that merchants control brand appearance. Because per-agent access control is a fair question for an agentic commerce platform, the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.
